summary: Fortis Inc. (TSX/NYSE: FTS) filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, reporting a routine quarterly dividend declaration by its Board of Directors. The press release announces dividends payable September 1, 2026, to shareholders of record August 19, 2026, covering eight series of preference shares and common shares at C$0.64 per share. No special-situation elements are present—no M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic action. The filing is a standard current report for a foreign private issuer, incorporated by reference into an existing shelf prospectus. The event is purely ordinary course dividend declaration, with no deal terms or extraordinary corporate action.
